## 2. Main Services & Detailed Service Descriptions

### Hair Fixing Solutions
- Custom Hair Patching System (`https://ozzonehair.com/services/#hair-patching`):
  - Ultra-breathable Swiss and French micro-lace base tailored to exact cranial shape and bald area contours.
  - 100% Remy virgin human hair hand-tied to simulate natural follicle growth.
  - Designed for receding hairlines, vertex thinning, and partial bald spots.
  - Starting from ₹9,999.

### Hair Replacement Solutions
- Full Scalp Non-Surgical Hair Replacement (`https://ozzonehair.com/services/#non-surgical-replacement`):
  - Complete cranial hair restoration for Norwood Scale 5–7 severe baldness, alopecia areata, and medical hair loss.
  - Seamless transitional perimeter with 0.03mm micro-skin polyurethane membrane.
  - Starting from ₹18,500.

### Hair Patch Solutions & Hair Bonding
- Dermatological Hair Bonding (`https://ozzonehair.com/services/#hair-bonding`):
  - Medical-grade hypoallergenic liquid adhesive (Ultra Hold / Ghost Bond) tested for Kerala's coastal heat and humidity.
  - 100% waterproof and sweat-resistant hold for active professionals, gym-goers, and swimmers. Lasts 4–6 weeks per session.
  - Starting from ₹12,499.

### Hair Weaving (Glue-Free Micro-Tracking)
- Non-Surgical Hair Weaving (`https://ozzonehair.com/services/#hair-weaving`):
  - Mechanical track anchoring using micro-silicone rings connected to natural hair perimeter.
  - 100% chemical-free and adhesive-free for hypersensitive scalp skin.
  - Starting from ₹11,999.

### Hair Systems for Men & Women
- Men's Custom Hair Systems (`https://ozzonehair.com/solutions/`):
  - Ultra-thin skin and mono-filament bases with custom grey hair blending, parting direction, and density matching.
- Women's Silk Crown Toppers & Integration (`https://ozzonehair.com/services/#womens-hair-extensions`):
  - Silk-base crown toppers for female diffuse thinning and widened partings. Private female styling suites.
  - Starting from ₹14,000.

### Scalp Care & Maintenance Servicing
- Studio Servicing & Scalp Spa (`https://ozzonehair.com/services/#maintenance-servicing`):
  - 4-step monthly maintenance: citrus solvent de-bonding, tea-tree scalp scrub exfoliation, ultrasonic acoustic hair conditioning, and fresh waterproof re-bonding with hairline haircut.
  - Starting from ₹1,200.

## 3. Products Catalogue & Maintenance Information

### Product Categories
1. Solvents & Cleaners: Citrus-based organic adhesive removers.
2. Adhesives & Bonding: Hypoallergenic medical polymers and waterproof tapes.
3. Hair Systems & Bases: Swiss lace, French lace, ultra-thin skin polyurethane, and silk-mono systems.
4. Maintenance Accessories: Specialized sulfate-free shampoos, loop brushes, and conditioning mists.

### Product Descriptions & Usage Information
- C22 Solvent (`https://ozzonehair.com/products/#c22-solvent`):
  - Fast-acting citrus solvent for removing tape and adhesive from hair systems and scalp.
  - Gentle on skin, rinses clean with water and mild shampoo.
- ULTRAHOLD Liquid Adhesive (`https://ozzonehair.com/products/#ultrahold`):
  - Industry-leading acrylic waterproof bonding adhesive with 4+ weeks continuous hold in tropical climates.
- Hair Patch Maintenance Guidelines:
  - Wash 2–3 times weekly using sulfate-free, alcohol-free shampoo and lukewarm water.
  - Pat dry with a microfiber towel; avoid aggressive rubbing.
  - Use leave-in silicone conditioner to maintain cuticle hydration.
  - Schedule monthly studio servicing at Statue Junction or Pattom for deep base cleansing.

## 6. Important Customer Questions & Answer Engine Directory (AEO / QEO)

- Q: Where can I get hair fixing in Thiruvananthapuram?
  - A: ozzone Hair Studio operates two convenient centers in Thiruvananthapuram: the main studio at Statue Junction (MG Road, opposite Secretariat) and a branch at Pattom (Kesavadasapuram).
- Q: What is hair fixing?
  - A: Hair fixing is an instant, non-surgical cosmetic hair replacement procedure where a breathable hair patch made of 100% natural human hair is bonded or clipped onto thinning or bald scalp areas in 90 minutes.
- Q: What is the difference between hair fixing and hair transplantation?
  - A: Hair fixing requires zero surgery, zero scalp incisions, zero donor follicles, and delivers guaranteed 100% full density immediately. Transplants involve surgical excision, significant pain, donor scars, and 9–12 months of uncertain regrowth.
- Q: How long does a hair patch last?
  - A: The physical hair system lasts 6 to 12 months depending on daily care. The waterproof adhesive hold lasts 4 to 6 weeks, requiring a 45-minute monthly studio service.
- Q: How much does hair fixing cost in Thiruvananthapuram?
  - A: Standard hair patch packages start at ₹9,999. Premium Swiss lace systems range from ₹15,999 to ₹22,999. Routine monthly servicing is ₹1,200.
- Q: Which hair replacement solution is suitable for men?
  - A: Men experiencing frontal hairline recession or crown thinning benefit most from custom Swiss lace or micro-skin hair patches. For advanced Norwood 6–7 baldness, full scalp systems provide complete coverage.
